APPROVE

Limitations:
- Required CI has not run for head `5b45070`: `CI for Main & Release Lines`, `Enterprise Contribution Guard` and `Mutation tests` are `action_required` (held for maintainer approval); only `label` and `license/cla` reported. Branch protection and the merge queue still gate the merge.

Checked the other embedding call sites: `vector.strategy.ts:147` (index) and `vector-index.service.ts:456` keep the `document` default, and the worker probe only exercises the client, so the `query` purpose is confined to the two search paths.

🏷️ label rationale <!-- om-auto-review-pr:label-rationale -->
- `bug` — Cohere queries were embedded with the document input type, degrading vector retrieval.
- `skip-qa` — provider option only: no UI, no API or DB shape change, new unit cases cover both branches with and without `outputDimensionality`.
- `priority-medium` — silent retrieval-quality loss, no data corruption.
- `risk-low` — the optional `purpose` defaults to `document`, so indexing and every other provider are unchanged.
- `merge-queue` — reviewed and approved; branch protection still holds the merge until required checks run.
